proposal.summary: The report describes a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in PKP Open Journal Systems 2.4.8 through >= 3.3 where attackers can inject code via the X-Forwarded-Host header.
proposal.cwe_quote: Cross-site scripting (XSS) via Host Header injection in PKP Open Journals System 2.4.8 >= 3.3 allows remote attackers to inject arbitary code via the X-Forwarded-Host Header.

AV.quote: allows remote attackers to inject arbitary code via the X-Forwarded-Host Header.

C.quote: Cross-site scripting (XSS) via Host Header injection in PKP Open Journals System 2.4.8 >= 3.3 allows remote attackers to inject arbitary code via the X-Forwarded-Host Header.

I.quote: Cross-site scripting (XSS) via Host Header injection in PKP Open Journals System 2.4.8 >= 3.3 allows remote attackers to inject arbitary code via the X-Forwarded-Host Header.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request the original report or proof-of-concept demonstrating where the X-Forwarded-Host value is reflected (response context), whether authentication is required, and any exploit HTTP request/response examples so CVSS metrics and impact can be finalized.

evidence_quotes.quote: Cross-site scripting (XSS) via Host Header injection in PKP Open Journals System 2.4.8 >= 3.3 allows remote attackers to inject arbitary code via the X-Forwarded-Host Header.
